contentGaps.title: WordPress Database Connection Error: Safe First Checks
contentGaps.demandEvidence: Research-backed editorial queue topic from official WordPress troubleshooting documentation. Search demand, impressions, and community volume have not been measured for this brief.
contentGaps.whyWeCanWin: Focus the guide on distinguishing configuration issues from host/database availability problems, preserving sensitive credentials, and knowing when to contact the host. This narrower troubleshooting intent complements the existing general site-down and plugin-conflict checklists.
outline: What the database-connection error indicates and what it does not diagnose by itself
Record the exact message, affected URLs, recent changes, and provider alerts before changing files
Check whether the host reports a database or resource issue before editing configuration
Protect credentials and backups; avoid publishing or copying wp-config.php contents
When to involve the hosting provider or a WordPress technician
